dedupeText: retro pop artist portrait 90s aesthetic urban pop 3d typography studio portrait high contrast yellow and black arched text subject framed by arched text above and diagonal rails below high contrast yellow and black apparel echoing the text color palette drop shadow on subject creating depth against a flat white void combine a high contrast studio portrait isolated on white with arched 3d extruded display typography in a primary color palette to create a retro pop aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered studio portrait of a smiling young male subject against a stark white background, featuring bold, arched 3D typography at the top and diagonal structural elements in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by arched text above and diagonal rails below
High-contrast yellow and black apparel echoing the text color palette
Drop shadow on subject creating depth against a flat white void

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, waist-up, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold arched text, move down to the subject's face, and follow the diagonal rails toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the subject and text, emphasizing the cutout effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow elements creates a vibrant, energetic feel against the neutral black and white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif or heavy block sans
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sheared to follow the radial arch
3D extrusion faces are shaded in grey to simulate metallic depth
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face; no secondary typography.

candidateDirections.reason: Strong slab serif foundation suitable for heavy 3D effects.
Heavy weight and compact counters match the density.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a young person in a black and yellow jacket, leaning on white diagonal railings, isolated on a pure white background with a subtle drop shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, arched 3D block text at the top. The text should have a yellow-to-orange gradient fill, a thick red outline, and a grey 3D extrusion pointing downwards.

verificationChecks: Is there a 3D extrusion on the lettering?
Are the diagonal rails present in the foreground?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact letterforms if they match a trademarked logo
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the subject cutout
Ensure the 3D extrusion perspective is consistent
Verify the red outline is thick and visible
Confirm the diagonal rails do not obscure the subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast studio portrait isolated on white with arched, 3D-extruded display typography in a primary color palette to create a retro-pop aesthetic.
